Person.description: An individual mentioned in or relevant to the case.

Location.description: A physical place referenced in evidence.

Event.description: A discrete occurrence with a timestamp.

Object.description: A physical item of evidentiary relevance.

Document.description: An uploaded evidence file (text, image, scan).

Statement.description: A specific claim or account made by a person.

PARTICIPATED_IN.description: A person participated in an event.

LOCATED_AT.description: An event took place at a location.

MENTIONED_IN.description: A person or object is mentioned in a document.

OWNS.description: A person owns or possesses an object.

RELATED_TO.description: A general relationship between two entities.

EXTRACTED_FROM.description: An entity was extracted from a document by the NLP pipeline.

meta.description: SatyaSutra investigation knowledge graph schema. Every edge carries an evidence_id to maintain full provenance and auditability.
